description: Guard for the Glowming campaign files: allow-list checked against the files on disk (guard.js), then a content check on writes.

hooks.prompt:
Judge only the TEXT this tool call would write: $TOOL_INPUT

BLOCK if the new text contains any of: a password, API key, token, card or bank number, or ID number; a cost price, landed cost, margin or internal funding split; another company's or client's private business that is not Glowming; a computer file path such as C:/Users/...; a NEW weight-loss, detox, appetite, cure or medical claim. Approved advert wording copied word for word is fine. ALLOW everything else. If you block, say in one plain sentence what to remove.
